title: Top Adventure Activities to Try This Summer in India
content:
Introduction

Summer is the perfect time to break free from routine and explore thrilling experiences across India. From river rafting to mountain trekking, India offers endless adventure opportunities for every type of traveler.

Whether you're escaping the heat of Delhi or planning a fun trip with friends, this guide covers the best adventure activities to try this summer - along with tips to do them on a budget.

River Rafting in Rishikesh

One of the most popular summer adventures in India!

 Why try it?

  • Thrilling rapids of the Ganga River
  • Perfect for beginners and pros
  • Budget-friendly packages available
  • Best Time: March to June
  • Cost: ₹600 -₹2000

Tip: Go for early morning slots for less crowd

Trekking in Manali

If you love mountains, trekking is a must-do.

Popular treks:

  • Hampta Pass
  • Beas Kund
  • Bhrigu Lake
  •  Scenic views + fresh air + adventure
  •  Best Time: May to July
  •  Cost: ₹1500 - ₹5000

Camping in Kasol

Camping is perfect for those who want both peace and adventure.

 Experience includes:

  • Bonfire nights
  • Riverside camping
  • Stargazing
  •  Best Time: April to June
  •  Cost: ₹800 - ₹2500

Paragliding in Bir Billing

Known as the paragliding capital of India.

Why it’s amazing:

  • Fly over scenic valleys
  • Once-in-a-lifetime experience
  •  Best Time: April to June
  •  Cost: ₹2000 - ₹4000

Mountain Biking in Leh

For hardcore adventure lovers.

 What to expect:

  • Challenging terrains
  • Stunning landscapes
  • High-altitude thrill
  •  Best Time: May to August
  • Cost: ₹2000+ per day

Bonus: Choose Adventure Travel Packages

Planning all activities individually can be confusing and costly.

You can opt for curated trips like Monks & Monkeys Travel Packages, which offer:

  • Pre-planned adventure itineraries
  • Budget-friendly group trips
  • Activities + stay + transport included

  Safety Tips for Adventure Travel

  • Always follow instructor guidelines
  • Wear proper safety gear
  • Avoid risky activities without guidance

Adventure travel in India is not just about thrill - it’s about creating unforgettable memories. From river rafting in Rishikesh to paragliding in Bir Billing, there’s something for everyone.

 Plan smart, stay safe, and make this summer truly exciting!
